name: reusable-workflow-builder
title: Reusable Workflow Builder
description: A local Open Design scenario that turns a short workflow goal into a scoped artifact workflow with discovery, planning, generation, and review.

query.en: Create a reusable Open Design workflow for {{workflowGoal}}. Target {{artifactKind}} for {{audience}} on {{platform}}. Use the supplied constraints, produce the appropriate local files, and finish with a readiness summary.

inputs.name: workflowGoal
inputs.label: Workflow goal
inputs.placeholder: turn a brand brief into a launch landing page workflow

inputs.name: artifactKind
inputs.label: Artifact kind
inputs.placeholder: prototype, deck, dashboard, landing page, plugin, image, video

inputs.name: audience
inputs.label: Audience
inputs.placeholder: product evaluators, internal team, customers, investors

inputs.name: platform
inputs.label: Platform
inputs.placeholder: responsive web, desktop web, iOS app, Android app, tablet app

inputs.name: constraints
inputs.default: Use the current project context and ask only for missing hard requirements.
inputs.label: Constraints
inputs.placeholder: brand rules, required sections, files to preserve, references, things to avoid
